% Pattern: number/class-section. IEEEtran prints \thesection as Roman, but a
% theorem numbered within the section prints the section in arabic: 2.1, not
% II.1. Seen in the gold pilot (set X).
% want theorem-1 statement/theorem 1.1
% want lemma-1 statement/lemma 2.1
% want theorem-2 statement/theorem 2.2
\documentclass[journal]{IEEEtran}
\newtheorem{theorem}{Theorem}[section]
\newtheorem{lemma}[theorem]{Lemma}
\begin{document}
\section{One}
\begin{theorem} Every compact space is bounded. \end{theorem}
\section{Two}
\begin{lemma} Every finite space is compact. \end{lemma}
\begin{theorem} Every finite space is bounded. \end{theorem}
\end{document}
